preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 parent integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p < i for i, p in enumerate(parents, start=2))
preconditions.description: For each vertex i from 2 to n, its parent pi satisfies 1 <= pi < i, ensuring a valid rooted tree structure with root 1.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

The output equals the number of distinct possible colorings of the tree vertices modulo 10^9 + 7, where a coloring is possible if it has a non-zero probability of occurring via the described random paint process starting from the root.
